pt: Sou desenvolvedor de software desde 2019. Comecei resolvendo problemas em hospitais, virei a chave pra IA quando os modelos da OpenAI ainda chamavam GPT-2 e eu tinha que explicar pra todo mundo o que era um "transformer".
Já fundei, vendi, vi falir e segui em frente. Hoje co-fundo a GoodStream — plataforma de document intelligence pra portfolio management — do Brasil, no fuso de Nova York, no terceiro café.
Em paralelo, sigo lutando com o mestrado em Ciência da Computação na PUC Minas. Sim, dá pra fazer as duas coisas. Não, não dá pra dormir bem.
en: I've been a software engineer since 2019. Started shipping software for hospitals, then jumped on the AI train back when OpenAI models were called GPT-2 and I had to explain to everyone what a "transformer" was.

I've founded, sold, watched things go under, and kept going. Today I'm a co-founder at GoodStream — a document intelligence platform for portfolio management — building from Brazil on New York time, on my third coffee.
On the side, I'm wrestling a master's degree in Computer Science at PUC Minas. Yes, you can do both. No, you can't sleep well.

note.en: in progress, on my own time
